pob.definition: n a numbered compartment in a post office where mail is put to be called for

pobbies.definition:
An old Yorkshire term for pieces of bread floating in warm milk given to young children or the elderly during sickness.
> Eat your pobbies Granny

pobl's test.translation: [医] 波耳氏试验(检球蛋白)

poblacion.translation: n. (菲律宾的)中心区，中心市镇; (智利等国家的)贫民区(或窟)；栅户区; (讲西班牙语国家的市镇的)区，社区

poblano.translation: n. 钟形青椒, 主要产于墨西哥。
